accounts.title: Your account
paragraphs: You sign in with your email address or a Google account. Keep access to your email and Google account secure: anyone with access to them can sign in as you.
You are responsible for activity under your account. You can delete your account at any time from your dashboard.

accountData.title: Account data
paragraphs: When you create an account, we store your email address, your sign-in method, the version of the Terms you accepted and your preferences. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google.
We keep account data until you delete your account, which removes it permanently.

processors.google: Google, if you choose to sign in with Google.
processors.hcaptcha: hCaptcha, when a captcha is shown, to tell people from bots.

storage.session: Sign-in cookies (sb-…-auth-token), set through Supabase Auth: keep you signed in securely. Kept until you sign out or your session expires.
storage.hcaptcha: hCaptcha: when a captcha is shown, hCaptcha may use cookies or storage on its own domain to tell people from bots.
